name: Section
description: A styled container for grouping related content, offering flexible layout options. Unlike Card, it doesn't have link functionality or hover effects, making it ideal for structuring static content areas.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding size. Also determines the gap between columns in grid layouts ('sm'=gap-4, 'md'=gap-8, 'lg'=gap-12).

props.name: layout
props.description: Layout structure for the content area ('single-column', 'two-column-equal', 'two-column-sidebar-right')

props.name: roundedTop
props.description: Whether the top corners should be rounded.

usage: Use Section as a container for grouping related content
For single-column layouts, simply wrap content in Section with desired padding
For two equal columns, set layout='two-column-equal' - columns split 50/50 on medium screens and larger
For sidebar layout, set layout='two-column-sidebar-right' and specify column spans on direct children using Tailwind classes (e.g., 'lg:col-span-8', 'lg:col-span-4')
The padding prop controls both inner padding and gap between columns in grid layouts
Grid layouts automatically stack to a single column on smaller screens
Pair with CardContent for consistent inner spacing within columns/content areas, especially when Section padding is set to 'none'

design: Provides a consistent container style (background, border-radius) without interactive elements
Offers 'single-column', 'two-column-equal', and 'two-column-sidebar-right' layout options via the layout prop
The padding prop controls both the inner padding and the gap between columns in grid layouts
Grid layouts stack to a single column on smaller screens
For 'two-column-sidebar-right', children must specify their responsive column spans (e.g., 'lg:col-span-8')
Pairs well with CardContent for consistent inner spacing within columns/content areas, especially when Section padding is set to 'none'
More semantically accurate than using Card for non-interactive content grouping
